name: Aura Renali
source:
The heroine of the story. Aura is a go-getter with a caring heart and stubborn streak. She loves cooking and wishes to become a successful chef one day like her mother. Her kind and curious nature leads her to trying to help the d'Lockes break a near-decade curse, but gets herself entangled in their personal affairs in the process. Can she solve all the mysteries revolving around this strange family?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=36483]Lemmasoft[/url]]
